_about: Public-domain Henry Melvill (1798-1871, Principal of the East India College, Haileybury, Canon of St Paul's, the most admired London preacher of his day) for the Word Hoard: Sermons ed. C. P. M'Ilvaine (2 vols, New York 1853), Sermons before the University of Cambridge (1836), Sermons on the Less Prominent Facts in Sacred Story (London 1843 and New York 1846), Sermons on Public Occasions (1846) and Lectures on Practical Subjects at St Margaret's, Lothbury (New York 1858), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 14 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

melvill-less-prominent-facts-2: Sermons on Certain of the Less Prominent Facts and References in Sacred Story, second series (New York: Stanford and Swords, 1846)
